title: 19-Year-Old Thinks He Can Outsmart Police With A Fake I.D.
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On February 12th, 2024. Officers were called to the airport regarding an underage man on a work trip trying to buy alcohol with a fake I.D. When officers spoke with him, he claimed that a friend that he just met at the airport gave him the I.D. to use and left. The man just kept lying to the officers until he slipped up and said it was a fake I.D. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
